_about: Non-US subdivision map regions for packaging/build_packs.py, so one region can be cut with the same code as a US state or a country. box is [west, south, east, north] in degrees from the official boundary, before the 0.15 degree margin subdivision_box adds. AT-9 is Vienna's ISO 3166-2:AT code; its box and its BEV VGD provenance are in docs/regions-at-proposed.json (merged proposal #264), and this file copies only the unpadded box so the build has one stable input. Listing a region here only makes a build possible. It does not publish it, does not ingest the Austrian layers, and carries no attribution: those stay with the region proposal and the source-snapshot work.

AT-9.title: Wien (Vienna)
